text: ROBI’s performance over the last few weeks was good, with 58 orders successfully delivered and a typical robot time of 98 seconds. The most frequent cause of failure was ‘unknown’ status, occurring 57 times, notably on orders [cite:2], [cite:3], and [cite:4]. There were also 37 orders with warnings, and the slowest order, #2, involved a water bottle and took 817 seconds to complete. **Focus your attention on reducing ‘unknown’ failures by reviewing the robot’s [[detection]] data for orders [cite:1] through [cite:63] to identify potential environmental factors.**
